reviews.text:
Swan Roofing is a top notch company.  Insurance did not want to pay when my roof was hail damaged.  Mark Lenzer went above and beyond to provide me with everything needed to get this claim processed.  His years of experience proved valuable in convincing insurance this roof needed to be replaced.  Even though it was a small job, he didn't treat it that way.  He took care of my home as if it were his own.
I couldn't be happier with my new roof.  It is beautiful!
reviews.author: Anita Haskell

reviews.text: We had our roof replaced by another company in 2023, but experienced water infiltration to 2 rooms during short-lived but heavy storms last week. Our original roofer blamed leaf debris buildup, but that didn't seem to fully explain the large amount of water that came into our home. I called Swan for a 2nd opinion. Mark came out within 24 hours, did a thorough assessment, took pictures, answered questions, and made suggestions as to where the leak may have occurred and recommendation/estimate to repair. He was quick to respond and very kind and helpful in every way. Swans team was ready to get us fixed ASAP and for a reasonable cost. I would have proceeded to use this company, however as our roof was still under workmanship warranty from the original installer, we took Marks report back to them and they are coming to handle the work free of charge under their warranty. Mark has continued to stay in touch as a backup, should it be needed. Their attention to our concerns and more timely response to our leak would have me without a doubt reecommend Swan Roofing for their above and beyond customer service. I will definitely call Swan first the next time we are in the market for exterior construction needs!
reviews.author: Tami G

reviews.text: Amazing experience with Kirk and his whole team who went above and beyond for me. I had a leak in my TPO/mansard roof and they rushed right out and it was fixed very quickly. Great communication and they treated my home with as much care as if it were their own.
reviews.author: Katherine Faraldo

reviews.text: Soon after buying my house in Plano my roof was damaged by hail. I called every roofer on the list my insurance agent gave me, and Swan was the only one to show up.  Nearly 25 years later I did not hesitate to go with Swan again, and I am very pleased with both results and price. Mark proposed a perfectly acceptable solution, became my trusted expert advisor as he helped me refine that to include the enhancements I wanted, and ensured that even the one weird thing I wanted was implemented correctly. And thanks to Chrisanto, my new ridge vents are the best looking in the neighborhood. Texas does not license or regulate roofers, so Swan's membership in both the Roofing Contractors Association of Texas and the North Texas Roofing Contractors Association, and their certifications with multiple manufacturers (for example their GAF Master Elite status) are objective indicators of their commitment to excellence.
reviews.author: Jay Dunning

reviews.text: The best roofing company run by a man you can trust Kirk Swan got up on the roof to oversee the work! Highly recommend this company for all your roofing needs - have used them on three houses for over 30 years!  thanks Kirk!
reviews.author: Jo Ann Burke

reviews.text: A fine job.   Love the quality of work and the results.  The roof and gutter teams worked extremely hard and did great worked long hours to get the job done.  The gutters actually shine.  Looks great.  Thank you so much.
reviews.author: Michael

reviews.text: I had an exceptional experience using Swan Roofing. From the initial inspection to completion of my roof replacement, they were there every step of the way.  Jason, Chrisanto, Jaime, Fatima and the roofing crew were all awesome.  The communication, attention to detail, workmanship, and follow-through after the project was completed was outstanding.  They coordinated with my insurance company, got the necessary city permit and handled all the details necessary to get my new roof.  It was a seamless process for me as a customer.  It was a no-hassle experience.  I can't recommend them enough.
reviews.author: Linda Bastida

reviews.text: After a few door knocker’s came and told me I needed a roof, I called Swan Roofing. Swan sent Jason Perez out with a drone and performed a thorough inspection of my roof. He was honest in telling me that it would be unwise to make an insurance claim as it would be a hit to my insurance premiums as well as a waste of my time. I know who I will call when the time comes to replace my roof. Thank you Swan Roofing for running a honest and reputable company.
reviews.author: Jonathan Rollins
